_meta.note: #713 — ONE rendered tooltip per rankable affix name that has a numeric carrier, read from a carrier item page's rendered HTML (span.tooltip) via the paced same-origin api.php parse loop in docs/wiki-evidence/harvest-method.md. The condition prose lives in the enchantment TEMPLATE, so one rendering per name is the evidence for every carrier. `tooltip` is verbatim (with | = & ? stripped by the privacy guard); `label` is the enchantment name the wiki engraves. `provenance`: stated (tooltip captured) or unmatched (the page rendered tooltips but none named this affix — recorded with the labels seen so the gap is visible, never inferred).

_meta.false_negative_note: #715 -- TWICE a source was searched for OUR canonical name and returned a false negative while carrying the grant under different wording: `Eldritch Blast Dice` is the table row `Blast Dice`, and `Bard Song Charge` / `Turn Undead Charge` are prose about additional songs/attempts per rest.
